fangwurm_angry.m: I am sad that you took the blood for yourself instead of trying to help Anakis' sister. Please leave now.

fangwurm_angry_2.m: Anakis told me that you took the blood for yourself instead of trying to help his sister. Please leave now.

fangwurm_info_about_blood.m:
The Basilisk's blood has special properties. It can protect against damage if applied to the skin. Fresh, warm, Basilisks blood might even heal a person that has been turned to stone.
But how can you kill a Basilisk if you can't even look at it? It has a very strong defense.
r: You are right, it will not be possible to kill the Basilisk.
I will find a way to kill the Basilisk.

fangwurm_info_basilisk.m: The Basilisk will turn you to stone when you go near him and your eyes meet its eyes. You should not look at it. Come back to me if you know what happened to Anakis' sister.

fangwurm_info_vial.m:
You would need a special crystal vial that is resistant to the Basilisk's blood to handle it. The potion maker in Fallhaven might sell them. 
May the Shadow be with you.

fangwurm_talking.m: May the Shadow be with you.
r: I killed the Basilisk and took the blood for myself.
I killed the Basilisk in the cave.
Can you please tell me again, what you know about the Basilisk's blood?
I believe that Anakis' sister was turned to stone by the Basilisk in the cave. Do you have any idea if I could help her?
Anakis' sister is missing. Can you tell me more about the Basilisk in the cave?
I am looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me.

fangwurm_talking_1a.m: Yes, I know someone who looks almost like you, but he and his parents are from this town.

fangwurm_thank_killing_basilisk.m: Thank you for killing the Basilisk, but it would be better if you had talked to me before killing it, because its magical blood is now dried up and wasted. May the Shadow always be with you.

fangwurm_thank_killing_basilisk_2.m: Anakis told me that you killed the Basilisk. Thank you, but it would be better if you had talked to me before killing it, because its magical blood is now dried up and wasted. May the Shadow always be with you.

fangwurm_thank_rescuing_sister.m: Juttarka told me that you saved her life. Thank you. May the Shadow always be with you.
